title: Accessibility: Alt Text & Content Adaptation

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Accessibility: Alt Text & Content Adaptation": Generate high-quality alt text for educational images, diagrams and equations and adapt content for learners with disabilities. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluated on photos not diagrams.
